title: UI Refinement Pass (v3.1.2)
summary: Spacing, styling, and theme behavior were refined so everyday navigation feels more cohesive.
bodyMarkdown:
## Highlights

- Cleaned up component styling
- Improved spacing and layout consistency
- Improved theme consistency across screens

## Improvements

- Reduced visual rough edges

## Why this matters

UI Refinement Pass (v3.1.2) is one of those tidy-up releases that does not need a parade, but it still helps the app feel less fussy. Small fixes matter here because CogniFocus is supposed to get out of your way fast. Tap in, start the thing, dodge the scroll spiral, continue your tiny heroic quest. That is the whole deal.

- Cleaned up component styling gets a little more room to breathe.
- Improved spacing and layout consistency gets a little more room to breathe.
- Improved theme consistency across screens gets a little more room to breathe.
- Reduced visual rough edges gets a little more room to breathe.

So yes, this is a smaller note. The point is still real: fewer weird little moments, clearer feedback, and less friction between you and the session you meant to start. The Goblin may still be dramatic about it, obviously, but the app should feel calmer where it counts.
